channel.title: ICIS - Press Releases
channel.description: Press releases e anúncios da ICIS (gerado via API REST do WordPress).

item.title: ICIS introduces new rLDPE pellet pricing reflecting regulatory driven market evolution
item.description: ICIS introduces new rLDPE pellet pricing to reflect evolving EU regulations and growing demand for recycled plastics in packaging and circular economy markets.

item.title: AkzoNobel CEO Greg Poux-Guillaume is the 2026 ICIS CEO of the Year
item.description: AkzoNobel CEO Greg Poux-Guillaume has been named the 2026 ICIS CEO of the Year, recognised by industry peers for leadership, innovation and outstanding achievement in the global chemical industry.

item.title: ICIS Top 100 Chemical Distributors Ranking for 2026 Unveiled
item.description: Explore the 2026 ICIS Top 100 Chemical Distributors ranking, featuring the world’s leading chemical distributors, regional leaders and the latest industry insights based on 2025 sales.

item.title: ICIS expands polymer demand insight across global plastics markets
item.description: ICIS expands polymer demand insights with new data and analysis, helping customers understand global plastics market trends and make better business decisions.

item.title: 12th ICIS World Polyolefins Conference 2026
item.description: Join the 2026 ICIS World Polyolefins Conference as industry leaders explore Europe’s polyolefins outlook, market volatility, supply and demand trends.

item.title: ICIS Launches Iberian and Italian rPET Pricing
item.description: ICIS expands its recycled PET market coverage with new Iberian and Italian rPET flake price assessments, improving transparency across European markets.

item.title: ICIS and ICE Introduce Base Oils Futures
item.description: ICIS and ICE launch exchange-backed base oils futures using ICIS benchmarks, bringing new risk management tools to the market.

item.title: 2026 ICIS Top 40 Power Players winner
item.description: ICIS Top 40 Power Players 2026 ranks global chemical leaders, with ADNOC CEO Dr Sultan Ahmed Al Jaber named #1

item.title: ICIS meets IOSCO’s PRA Principles for the 13th consecutive year
item.description: ICIS passes the IOSCO audit for the 13th year, reaffirming its commitment to transparent, industry-leading commodity price methodology.

item.title: ICIS and Plan Grow Do announce exclusive training programme to drive sales evolution in a changing petrochemical landscape
item.description: ICIS and PGD have partnered to create new exclusive sales workshops at ICIS events

item.title: ICIS and CPCIF Unveil New Study Revealing Wide-Ranging Impacts of EU Circularity Regulation on Global Recycled Plastics Demand
item.description: A new joint study by ICIS and CPCIF explores the effects of EU regulatory changes on China’s manufacturing sector.

item.title: ICIS Top 100 Chemical companies 2025
item.description: Discover the latest ICIS Top 100 Chemical Companies ranking, with insights into the industry’s biggest players and global market leaders.

item.title: ADNOC CEO Dr Sultan Al Jaber is the 2025 ICIS CEO of the Year
item.description: ICIS names ADNOC CEO Dr. Sultan Al Jaber as CEO of the Year 2025, recognising his leadership in global chemicals and energy.

item.title: 2025 ICIS Top 100 Chemical Distributors Ranking Revealed
item.description: ICIS unveils the 2025 Top 100 Chemical Distributors, spotlighting global leaders and key trends in the chemical supply chain.

item.title: ICIS Announces New Additions to Leadership Team
item.description: ICIS announces three key executive appointments to strengthen leadership and drive its global commodity intelligence strategy.

item.title: 2025 Top 40 Power Players Winner
item.description: ICIS has named its 2025 Top 40 Power Player winner, recognising the industry leader driving major impact across the global chemical sector.

item.title: ICIS Innovation Awards 2024 winners celebrated
item.description: Linde, BASF and SABIC have won the ICIS Innovation Awards 2024 for their electric cracker furnace, the world’s first to be built at demonstration scale

item.title: ICIS meets IOSCO’s PRA Principles for the 12th consecutive year
item.description: ICIS has completed its independent assurance review for the 12th consecutive year, confirming the strength of its price reporting services.

item.title: ICIS Announces Global Launch of Ask ICIS
item.description: ICIS launches Ask ICIS, a generative AI assistant giving subscribers fast access to leading energy and chemicals market intelligence.

item.title: The ICIS Top 100 Chemical Companies unveiled
item.description: ICIS has announced the ICIS Top 100 Chemical Companies, a global ranking of the leading chemical producers worldwide based on 2023 sales.
